title: Southern Charm with Skyline Views-Two Homes
description:
Need space for a large group?
This listing combines two side by side homes and the amount to book is for both homes.  Booking price is for BOTH homes
*
You'll be staying less than 3 miles from Honky Tonk Broadway, and be a quick (affordable) Uber to the heart of  Music City.
*
If you are looking for comfort, space, and room to gather with friends/family and great wifi..we are your people. You'll find comfy beds, plenty of extra towels, cleaning supplies, and everything you need for your stay.

The space
Why you will be glad you stayed with us...
Your will have two homes for your group, which gives you plenty of space to gather and enough space to have some down time apart.  

What make us different from the other properties you've been comparing?
Hospitality.

Our goal is to answer any questions before you come to Nashville. If you need recommendations on restaurants, catering, concierge services or experiences, we are here to help.

We have bragging rights on our comfortable beds (no bunkbeds!).
*
You can expect plenty of kitchen space, pots, pans, and appliances if you prefer to stay in and cook.  
*
Corporate Groups are welcomed.
We've hosted multiple retreats and groups here for conventions.  The location makes it easy to commute to the convention center and downtown office buildings.   

Here to visit your college student? You’ll will be staying super close to Belmont/Vanderbilt.
  
The "Little Things"
Our cleaners take pride in having this property sparkling clean.

Here are the things in stock during your stay:
-Shampoo
-Conditioner
-Body wash
-Extra towels
-Laundry detergent
-Multiple Coffee Makers (Mr. Coffee & Keurig) 

Other things include:
-Attached Two Car Garage with additional off street parking
-High Speed Wifi (password/network are provided at check-in)
-Keyless keypad entry
-Nest Thermostats
-Full length mirrors

This is a permitted property
This is a PET FREE and SMOKE FREE Property.

Guest access
This listing combines two homes that are side by side with the exact same floor plan and amenities and square footage.

Other things to note
Please note, we use Noise Aware a noise monitoring service.  This is to detect noise/sound levels only.  It does not record words/voices.  We use Noise Aware to conform with the local  Metro Nashville mandated quiet hours: 10pm-7am daily. 
....
We also have exterior cameras on property at entry points.  We do NOT have cameras inside of the property.
